Bug_Title: DMI: Bad constant value for month (DMI_BAD_MONTH)
Bug_Details:
This code passes a constant month
value outside the expected range of 0..11 to a method.
Bug_Explanation: A constant value for month is passed outside the expected range of 0..11 to a method. In Java's Calendar class, month values are 0-based, i.e., they range from 0 (January) to 11 (December). Passing a value of 13 would result in an out-of-range error.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method. The method attempts to set an invalid month value of 13 in the Calendar instance. This attempt results in an IllegalArgumentException being thrown.
